### How Alcohol Affects Vitamin B

- **Reduced absorption:** Alcohol can interfere with how well your gut absorbs B vitamins (including B1, B2, B7, B9, and B12).⁠Everyday Health  +1[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF15isVmkO51drbsxz_tI8NCOFBRw0jB0XBR7JQzPJFzJkyl5K1EuP3sWVvwP38axnRW02W0cj5YrQAT74I2yAr4_hHZnY4N4IQa6oGHSXrYTPbtTkDLuD0CYqS6EpgdeqTcyHaSeMDnPiMdw-RZvftnZrV6DfQ6G-chho_0PoDXt8Tw3SPwwkNXj4ApUK)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpAEBxCJF1zvmRS7EP8ubylObFcOMqfHBJzvUsdB3UW0MFhXdhibxQXEONtxp_iEAR10pUIcxVWYTbk2sTqzdxTzHZjxV7P8jmDdR8D6bKV-EB_c2PYH4BITG0kh6pG7scPV7cFsUubOTXzAyLN8oHlpTcqNI3vqh3KvTkJTJMA-KUl-wWDLN7IyRuClsrhtyA6wErFVpDPvVCk3Oux6M_6PSaHEWDg)
- **Depletion over time:** Frequent or heavy drinking can lower baseline B vitamin levels—especially thiamine (B1) and B12—which contributes to fatigue and, with chronic heavy use, serious neurological issues.⁠Sunshine Behavioral Health  +2[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF13GNErsUQSCXvMcpFwQJ8Pm11o0Aakhpi-yKVfaANmRxOOE-RLohwkpU2bQsmO8zXEEIpPSVe4N2XNKY1S8zXwuEr25JaOIfKcdAdvK5-jRZD2vUudHgUWxAk9AauxpYcwhEaIl8_wH_enY_TmiQ-WsLU_aorInBFgNGBTDtwHYQmoNasw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF15isVmkO51drbsxz_tI8NCOFBRw0jB0XBR7JQzPJFzJkyl5K1EuP3sWVvwP38axnRW02W0cj5YrQAT74I2yAr4_hHZnY4N4IQa6oGHSXrYTPbtTkDLuD0CYqS6EpgdeqTcyHaSeMDnPiMdw-RZvftnZrV6DfQ6G-chho_0PoDXt8Tw3SPwwkNXj4ApUK)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpAEBxCJF1zvmRS7EP8ubylObFcOMqfHBJzvUsdB3UW0MFhXdhibxQXEONtxp_iEAR10pUIcxVWYTbk2sTqzdxTzHZjxV7P8jmDdR8D6bKV-EB_c2PYH4BITG0kh6pG7scPV7cFsUubOTXzAyLN8oHlpTcqNI3vqh3KvTkJTJMA-KUl-wWDLN7IyRuClsrhtyA6wErFVpDPvVCk3Oux6M_6PSaHEWDg)
- **Limited acute payoff:** Taking a large dose right before or after drinking does not reliably speed up alcohol clearance or stop hangover symptoms.⁠National Institutes of Health (NIH) | (.gov) +1[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXVMNb4O6FwelCSZ4ewrAx_iS-oIy5ZDF5MAfwH67xu-5x2ucbtIqwtrQL_WN2rH4tXWnl60iz29fbbakiwcc9GVafjVY_MmEKV9AZGtB-M4c6mmsRfYpA5nolAqhYUsujrcj2qwWyZQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF15isVmkO51drbsxz_tI8NCOFBRw0jB0XBR7JQzPJFzJkyl5K1EuP3sWVvwP38axnRW02W0cj5YrQAT74I2yAr4_hHZnY4N4IQa6oGHSXrYTPbtTkDLuD0CYqS6EpgdeqTcyHaSeMDnPiMdw-RZvftnZrV6DfQ6G-chho_0PoDXt8Tw3SPwwkNXj4ApUK)

### What Actually Helps More

- **Hydration and electrolytes:** Water or electrolyte drinks address dehydration, a primary driver of hangover symptoms.
- **Food and pacing:** Eating before drinking slows alcohol absorption, and pacing drinks or alternating with water limits how much alcohol you consume.
